sources.reading_depth: README, STOCK, CHANGES, pins and executed source; root and ESM-IF1 docs compared.
sources.finding: Exact mode supports fixed-site design probabilities but refuses direct conditional/score-only modes. Use pinned source, record runtime deviations and compare stock output. The default two weight files are kit-pinned; extra 010/030 weights are pinned here by upstream commit and recorded digests.

sources.reading_depth: Official inference documentation and sampling/conditional-scoring source.
sources.finding: Native-sequence-conditioned inverse folding is a separate representation from the earlier sequence models. Four checkpoints remain related; fixed-backbone likelihood is not a calibrated stability or functional endpoint.

sources.reading_depth: Indexed primary results on controls, Figure 3 references and discussion; previous stored control labels retained. Direct DOI retrieval failed.
sources.finding: 2012 study reports reduced stability/function for V793R, K795R, D911N and K795A; D882N/A retained the measured reconstitution endpoints. These are endpoint-specific labels, not clinical benign/pathogenic labels.

sources.reading_depth: Indexed primary abstract, Fig.4b/results and discussion; direct PMC browser retrieval challenged. Supplement not independently inspected.
sources.finding: 2019 study reports D882N lacks CENP-E phosphorylation while retaining protein stability. This challenges treating the historical retained control as universally functional; it does not directly remeasure every 2012 segregation endpoint.

sources.reading_depth: Indexed primary introduction, D882N/A KARD-S676 results, PP2A recruitment and discussion. Direct page open failed.
sources.finding: 2020 study retains D882N/A stability and S676 signals and supports an indirect scaffolding role; authors do not exclude catalysis under untested conditions. Preserve both mechanistic accounts. Require abundance, KARD/PP2A and chromosome-attachment endpoints rather than a catalytic proxy alone.

sources.reading_depth: Indexed primary abstract and benchmark rationale; direct PMC page challenged.
sources.finding: Sampling and ranking protein variants are different tasks; generic design success does not validate target-specific functional scoring.

sources.reading_depth: Prior v27 selected-section review retained; current direct retrieval challenged.
sources.finding: Shared viability/proliferation response can confound expression matching. Current symmetric held-out projection is a new sensitivity design, not the paper's validated viability model and not a causal adjustment.

sources.reading_depth: Primary indexed trial abstract and interpretation; prior Track 2 trial review retained.
sources.finding: ARST1431 did not demonstrate an event-free-survival benefit from adding temsirolimus to its RMS chemotherapy regimen. This challenges extrapolating mTOR target matching to clinical efficacy; it is not a direct test of everolimus in MVA functional rescue.

sources.reading_depth: Official oncology/TSC product label warnings and pharmacokinetic distribution sections; formulation/indication scope retained.
sources.finding: Infection, noninfectious pneumonitis, renal failure and myelosuppression remain material risks. Blood/plasma distribution and protein binding prevent treating nominal culture exposure as an established unbound tissue margin. No dose advice or individual risk estimate is generated.

decisions: Keep frozen original control ordering but label it 2012 endpoint separation; add explicit D882N endpoint conflict, no relabelling to improve model performance.
Evaluate query and competing targets outside projection fitting. Report within-fold denominators and repeated-partition dependence.
Preserve all previous drug dispositions and biological/exposure gates pending relevant functional evidence.
ProteinMPNN chosen for the control question; additional ligand/binder generation cannot resolve current unqualified endogenous function.
Failed RMS trial and official safety/PK counterevidence preserve the existing clinical exposure and injury gates; neither proves that all mTOR research hypotheses are false.
Scaffolding/PP2A recruitment remains a competing mechanistic branch to test, not a new approved-drug priority; no HCQ promotion by elimination.
limits: No new treatment recommendation, on-demand genomic inference, raw subject transfer or organizer/family contact.
Search results did not constitute a systematic correction/retraction audit.
New source reading did not independently verify supplements or published raw experimental data.
